{{Top|leg}}
'''Master Trail Guide''' was a title given to a Wookiee who had mastered the various paths of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. A master trail guide's job was to guide travelers on the trail down to the various levels and paths, making sure they got there safely and soundly.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Master Trail Guide was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Achonnko]].
